decisions.rationale: The user confirmed the repackaged container carries its upstream grant: "SWE-smith and CalibForge-rebuilt -> these should be fine theyre the same licenses as swesmith and calibforge right?" The upstream SWE-bench/SWE-smith is MIT and the automated checker PASSes its pinned card at ea6d7173829c7ec8fa16c22055699ff2e9188091 (P1). The raw checker escalation at this pin comes from the TaskTrove aggregate card (license: apache-2.0, cc-by-4.0, mit, other) reached through the container's recorded open-athena/task-trove@0e8137a6a1eca1e2c8c12eeb90a16c5d7f1f750c release pin. The candidate card revision 7374cb17fe7537b94afd35f3bcba2d8b7ec218da declares the checked upstream grant and PASSes its exact-pin check. Training use only; an exception does not transfer to a new revision.
